title: Leading the Happy Landing band and its changing members
summary: After a dispute Jiles took over Israel's band at the Happy Landing and hired Andrew Morgan; he explains how sidemen swapped between bands.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So who else did you have in the band at Happy Landing?

Well, at the Happy Landing, when I first went to the Happy Landing it was Israel band. Let's show you how it alternates around that you can understand what I meant about you playing with different fellas. Well it was a misunderstanding between Israel and the band. So we all quit. And the people at the Happy Landing want to know why we all quit and sent for me. And that's because they get the same band back without Israel. Then I hired Andrew Morgan to play in the band. And then the band, which was Sam, come up and said it was Andrew Morgan's job and I hired Andrew Morgan, that's what I can't understand was in the magazine. That would be straight. Now definitely, you know when you first met me it was with Israel, but that was not my band.
